notes.title: In-game challenges with your friends
notes.notes: [p]Challenge your friends with this new feature![/p][p][/p][p]If one of your friends already plays Grid Warriors, you can challenge him/her to beat your best builds. Just beat one of the bosses on the map to take their place and challenge your friends to beat your characters.[/p][p][/p][p]Invite your friends to install the demo to be able to challenge them![/p]

notes.title: Demo ready for the Indie Assemble initiative!
notes.notes:
There have been many changes since the last news, but the most important one is a major change in the game modes, allowing much more freedom and options.

In these latest versions of the demo you can see how the final game will look like and the scenarios that will compose it.

Check it out during the Indie Assemble taking place between March 5th and 11th!

notes.title: Unlockable characters and scenarios
notes.notes:
A first version of a feature that will be key to the player's progress in the game is ready: the possibility of unlocking new scenarios and characters.

In addition, the game now allows the player to choose the starting character for each game.

The scenarios can be considered as different game modes, which will add variability to the games.


With this latest update, the demo is now approaching its final form.
We hope you like where the game is heading.

notes.title: New demo available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have updated the demo with a new feature that we are waiting for: the adventure map, where you will be able to collect materials to improve your equipment.

On this map you will also see villages whose market you can visit (this is where you will find the old store), as well as castles where you can recruit new adventurers (which is now optional).

Additionally, many aspects of the demo have been improved, and many new recipes have been added.

We hope you like it :)

notes.title: Implemented item combination system
notes.notes:
In addition to changing the shape of items, the forge now also allows you to combine certain items to make better ones. A new button has been added in the forge to see the "recipes" available.

A handful of new items with their recipes have been added (including some plants and potions), and many more will be added in the future.

notes.title: Building the demo
notes.notes:
We have updated the demo with a little more content so that you can try more things (although it is still far from being considered a truly playable game).

- First version of the character improvement system.
- Number of battles increased to 5.
- 3 characters in the fifth battle.
- Added enemy builds to face randomly.
- Added fire and ice daggers, and vitality rune.

notes.title: Demo available for the Endless Replayability Fest
notes.notes:
The new Demo of the game is now available!

For now it is just an alpha version that will allow you to get an idea of the game, but we will gradually update it until you can play it to its full potential.
